description: This file contains the definition of the ExecApprovalEvaluation struct and the ExecApprovalEvaluator enum, which provide functionality for evaluating command approvals, security checks, and permissions within an application. It includes logic for assessing allowlists, security settings, and skill-based trust evaluations.

classes.name: ExecApprovalEvaluation
classes.description: A struct representing the result of an approval evaluation for a command, including command details, security policy, allowlist matches, and trust assessments.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates whether a command is approved based on security policies, allowlists, and trusted skills. Returns an ExecApprovalEvaluation object containing the assessment results.

methods.name: isSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Determines if the command resolution is auto-allowed based on trusted skill bins and resolved paths.

methods.name: _testIsSkillAutoAllowed
methods.description: Private test method alias for isSkillAutoAllowed, used for unit testing.
